displayName: Room server: slow delivery of game events

documentation.content: For 10 minutes, 1 game event in 20 took more than 500 ms from being published to reaching the sockets of an instance: the progress of a player is late on the other devices. Look at the database (Cloud SQL CPU and connections) and at the instances of the room server.

conditions.displayName: p95 of the delivery above 500 ms for 10 minutes
